recommendation: Keep the audit as-is for FHIR-18846. If the delegated IG publication URL or moved mapping details need correction, handle that under FHIR-53085 or a new CDS work group issue rather than reopening this STU3 request.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive STU3 CDS request to provide clearer mappings between CDS Hooks constructs and FHIR resources, including prefetch request data to PlanDefinition/DataRequirement inputs and CDS Hooks responses to GuidanceResponse/RequestGroup.
initial_application: Jira records GH#:20fd62db2d, and git commit 20fd62db2d557dd133bd32041d93ba3f4edbd62b explicitly included GF#18846 and added the requested hook, service, prefetch, GuidanceResponse, and RequestGroup mapping guidance to source/clinicalreasoning-cds-on-fhir.html. Later source history renamed RequestGroup to RequestOrchestration.
additional_context: The current Clinical Reasoning page is in build scope via source/hierarchy.xml and the active Clinical Reasoning resources in source/fhir.ini. Applied issue FHIR-53085 later moved most CDS-on-FHIR page content, profiles, and concept maps into the Using FHIR Clinical Reasoning with CDS Hooks IG and left core with an informative overview and IG links. FHIR-48393 separately moved the CDS Hooks profiles out of base FHIR. The IG source contains the detailed mappings, including DataRequirement-to-prefetch and CDS Hooks response-to-RequestOrchestration tables.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Re-adding the detailed tables to FHIR core would duplicate and partially reverse the later applied decision to maintain them in the dedicated IG.
